---
description: "Use when updating or verifying files that are generated by the rule system or other generators. Covers rule-generated artifacts and the repo map generator."
---

## Rule-generated files (do not edit directly)

Examples:

- .clinerules/10-core-rules.md (from rule-targets.yaml)
- memory-viewers/README.md (from memory-viewers/rule-targets.yaml)
- memory-api/README.md (from memory-api/rule-targets.yaml)

To update a generated file, edit the corresponding rule entry and run the sync tool, then stage both the generated output and rule entry before committing.

Suggested commands:

cargo run -p rule-cli --bin rule -- sync-targets --config rule-targets.yaml
git add .clinerules/10-core-rules.md .rule/rules/<id>/
git commit -m "chore(rule): regenerate targets"

## Repo map

repo_map.toon is produced by the peek CLI. Refresh when workspace layout or agent files change:

cargo run -p peek-cli -- . --repo-map --output repo_map.toon
git add repo_map.toon

## Agent ownership and global rules

Agent customization files and global policy live in AGENTS.md. See [AGENTS.md](../../../AGENTS.md) for repository-wide principles and ownership rules.
